title: Preallocate INSERT index keys
summary: Replaced ordinary secondary index key format! construction in INSERT paths with an explicit-capacity helper.

verification.focused: Indexed text insert, BTree index creation, secondary-index delete, upsert/cache, COPY index lookup, and INSERT SELECT focused tests passed
verification.integration: cargo test --test sql_dml -- --nocapture passed 44/44; cargo test --test sql_index_cache -- --nocapture passed 38/38
verification.search: rg 'index_key = format!\(|"index:\{}:\{}:\{}:\{}"' src/execution/dml/insert.rs -n returned no matches

result: INSERT still writes index:<table>:<column>:<value>:<row_id> keys, but avoids the format! allocation path for ordinary secondary index entries.
